input.summary: Repeat the right spinner to build Orbit bonus, collect it at the upper-right rollunder, and add Double Bonus only after a safe level-six vari-target test.

quickInfo.name: Orbit lamps
quickInfo.summary: Spinner spins, bumpers, and selected targets advance the ten-lamp ring, whose completion adds 10,000 bonus.

quickInfo.name: Bonus collect
quickInfo.summary: The upper-right rollunder collects and resets the built bonus, then gives a new plunge.

quickInfo.name: Vari-target
quickInfo.summary: Deeper hits score and advance more bonus, and a level-six hit lights Double Bonus.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: A full vari-target hit lights Double Bonus, which is also active on the last ball under standard settings.

quickInfo.name: Lower gate
quickInfo.summary: The left inlane opens the right-outlane gate, which can award the current bonus during an outlane escape.

steps.text: Plunge the center top lane for one bonus advance. Keep the flippers ready for a direct center return.
Shoot the right spinner to advance the Orbit lamps and feed the upper bumpers.
modeNotes: Orbit lamps: A complete ten-lamp revolution adds one 10,000 bonus unit. Base bonus can reach 190,000.
Bumpers: Lit bumpers score more and advance Orbit lamps faster on standard three-ball settings.

steps.text: Guide the ball through the upper-right rollunder when the route appears. This collects and resets the built bonus.
Use the free plunge to restart the spinner and bumper build.
Test the vari-target only when a deep hit returns to the left flipper. Reach level six to light Double Bonus.
modeNotes: Vari-target: Each deeper level adds more bonus. Level six lights Double Bonus and can also collect a lit Special.

steps.text: When Double Bonus is active, continue spinner and rollunder cycles. Do not force another target hit solely for value.

fallback.title: Spinner and bumper build
fallback.when: Use this when the vari-target rebound is unsafe or the flippers cannot reach level six.

steps.text: Repeat the right spinner.
Use lit bumper action to move the Orbit lamps.
Guide the ball through the upper-right rollunder to collect bonus.
Use the next plunge to begin another cycle.

alternatives.title: Level-six vari-target
alternatives.when: Use this when the target accepts a full hit and returns the ball to a controlled left-flipper position.

steps.text: Cradle on the left flipper after a known feed.
Shoot the vari-target for a level-six hit.
Use the lit Double Bonus on later bonus builds and collects.
Advance the Orbit lamps through spinner spins and bumper hits.
Complete ten-lamp Orbit revolutions until the displayed base bonus reaches 190,000. Each revolution adds 10,000.
Collect bonus at the upper-right rollunder before the ball drains.
Repeat the build and collect cycle. Add Double Bonus when the vari-target is safe.

playfieldReferences.label: Orbit advance spinner
playfieldReferences.description: Right spinner used to advance Orbit lamps; each full revolution lights one Bonus lamp.
playfieldReferences.context: Repeat the right spinner while its return remains safe.

playfieldReferences.label: Orbit lamps
playfieldReferences.description: Ten center lamps advanced by the spinner, bumpers, rollovers, and selected targets to add bonus units.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus collect rollunder
playfieldReferences.description: Upper-right gate that awards and resets the built bonus before serving a new plunge.

playfieldReferences.label: Vari-target
playfieldReferences.description: Center-left target whose deepest level advances bonus and lights Double Bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: Right-outlane gate
playfieldReferences.description: Gate opened by the left inlane; a lit right-outlane escape can award the current bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: Advance Bonus skill-shot lane
playfieldReferences.description: Center lane in the upper-left group that advances bonus on the plunge.

techniques.name: Spinner-to-collect route
techniques.instruction: Shoot the right spinner. Nudge only when the bumper feed gives a clear path through the upper-right bonus rollunder.

techniques.name: Cradle
techniques.instruction: Cradle on the left flipper before testing the vari-target; stop if a deep hit does not return safely.

cautions.issue: The center skill-shot lane can return the ball through the middle of the flippers.
cautions.response: Watch the entire plunge. Keep both flippers ready before the ball leaves the top.

cautions.issue: Vari-target rebounds can center-drain or reach the left outlane.
cautions.response: Use the spinner route until one test hit proves that the target return is safe.

cautions.issue: Upper bumper action is the highest-risk part of the main route.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready and nudge before a bumper exit reaches an outlane divider.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm three-ball or five-ball settings because lit-bumper Orbit advances differ, and the last ball normally has Double Bonus.
Test whether the vari-target reaches level six and whether its rebound returns safely to the left flipper.
Learn the right-spinner, upper-bumper, and upper-right bonus-rollunder feeds before committing to repeated cycles.
input.simpleOverview: Super Orbit turns spinner and bumper hits into a ten-lamp Orbit bonus that the upper-right rollunder collects and resets. Repeat the right spinner, collect before the ball drains, and attempt the vari-target for Double Bonus only after its deepest return is proven safe.
input.overview: Super Orbit turns spinner and bumper hits into a ten-lamp Orbit bonus that the upper-right rollunder collects and resets. Repeat the right spinner and upper bumper action, take the rollunder collect, then rebuild. Add Double Bonus only after a controlled level-six vari-target test, and use the left inlane to open the right-outlane bonus gate when available.
